Guaranteed weight loss within 2–3 weeks; many people start seeing results within the very first week. 17,000+ members already!

Guaranteed results are achieved using the state of the art adaptive TDEE (total calorie burn of the day) tracking technique we've developed. It's sensorless, so no watch or other wearable is needed. It's way more accurate than those wearables (data included on the website), and our group has 2,000+ members ( https://macrocodex.app/community/ ). You can also read Play Store reviews.

All this completely free, no subscription or ads: https://macrocodex.app/

MacroCodex also works on both Android and iOS and any platform where PWA app can run.

Other other 2 apps are Android only (for now):

If you are looking for a workout app with Alpha Progression or MacroFactor Workout-like “Smart Progression,” or an app where you can run any program like Boostcamp but ad- and subscription-free, check out the Symbiote workout app (beta) https://symbiote-studio.macrocodex.app/

IF you are looking for AI photo Calorie tracking with lots of features which make it very fast to log food on daily basis checkout CalorieCodex (beta): https://caloriecodex.macrocodex.app/

All the apps have been under active development for a few months now.
